memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to Moses, "Count all the firstborn Israelite males who are a month old or more and make a list of their names. Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn of the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites. I am the Lord." So Moses counted all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the Lord commanded him. The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273. - Num 3:39-43 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God commands that the firstborn of Israel be counted, so that the Levites can be taken in their place, one for one. This is the theme of substitution again, worked out in careful, counted detail. God does not deal in vague ideas; He deals in real names and real numbers.

The firstborn had a special claim on God's attention because He had spared them in Egypt. Rather than requiring each family to give up their firstborn son to lifelong service, God graciously provided the Levites as substitutes. It was a mercy woven into the structure of the nation.

There is deep comfort in seeing how deliberate God is. He counts, He lists names, He arranges substitutes. Nothing is left to chance. The same careful God orders the details of your life too.

And once more, the pattern points forward. The whole system of one standing in for another was preparing God's people to understand what Christ would do. Every substitute in the Old Testament was a signpost to the great Substitute, Jesus, who would give His life for many (Mark 10:45).

When you feel lost in the crowd, remember: God knows your name, God counts you, and God has provided a Substitute for you in Christ. You are precious and accounted for.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- How does it comfort you that God knows your name and counts you?
- Do you see God's care in the details of your life?
- How does every Old Testament substitute point you to Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You know me by name and have provided Christ as my Substitute. Help me to trust Your care in every detail of my life. Amen.
